تلتقون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَقُونَ (taltaqūna) /tal.ta.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# تُلْتَقَوْنَ (tultaqawna) /tul.ta.qaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
